critique.evidence: Measured performance is demo-ready across all three viewports: FCP 52–76 ms, LCP 548–704 ms, TTFB 1.3–5.8 ms, and load/DOMContentLoaded 141–237 ms. Mobile and desktop CLS are effectively zero (0 and 0.0011); tablet CLS is higher but still acceptable at 0.0478. Frame sampling reports no long frames, with worst frames of 16.8 ms on mobile/tablet and 33.4 ms on desktop. There is no horizontal document overflow. The main limitation is transfer cost: 1,314,022 bytes over 17 requests at every viewport, dominated by 1,148,898 bytes of JavaScript.
critique.fix: Reduce the roughly 1.15 MB JavaScript payload through route/screen-level code splitting and dead-code removal, and reserve dimensions for the tablet element causing CLS so stability approaches the desktop/mobile result.
